## Change
Problem and resulting behavior. Link the owning issue (Closes #N) and companion
issue/PR; state compatibility/order if needed. Put root-cause evidence here.

## Risk and docs impact
Security/API/migration/operations impact. Link the one canonical doc changed, or
state why enduring rules/contracts are unchanged (zero evergreen-doc edits is valid).

## Verification
Commands and actual results at this head; distinguish missing prerequisites,
CI, mocked browser checks and unexecuted physical/live QA. Link evidence, not logs.

## Staging / release
Concise QA steps or not applicable with reason. For paired work record exact
BE/FE SHAs. No merge or deploy unless separately authorized.
